say:1:1322541001:1.text: Got a report that two Evergreen Conservatory students wandered into the Sorrowfall Lake ruins. You know how dangerous that place is.
say:1:1322541001:1.source_cn: 我刚才接到报告，有两位冬青学会的学员冒冒失失地进去了哀...

say:2:1322541002:1.text: The guards are running on fumes from constant patrols, and we can't spare anyone else... Can you go take a look? It's pretty urgent.
say:2:1322541002:1.source_cn: 侍卫们连轴巡逻已经很疲惫了，我们也抽调不出更多的人手…...
